rationale: The stable v1.82.0 read lifecycle, foreign HA document retirement and disconnected loader guard already permit a detached HA assignment to consume its Lit update without preserving a mandatory read intent. Preserve that current intent, including demand interrupted by another detach, and consume it on reattach through the existing owner. Keep loaded idle same-context frames, TTL, transport fences and writers; no second loader.

summary.ru: Полная карточка восстанавливает план после смены подключения Home Assistant вне DOM без ожидания следующего обновления HA.
summary.en: The full card restores its plan after Home Assistant changes while detached, without waiting for another HA update.
